title: AARTOS track tombstone
description: Published BY protocols/vendors/aartos/aartos_json.py when a previously-tracked identity stops being reported (an aircraft/unit's classification disappears from the AARTOS feed) — a delete marker on that object's last known topic, not a track update.
x-efdi-topic: last known {TOPIC_ROOT}/{domain}/aartos/passive_rf/{aff}/{entity}/{uid}/tracks/v1 for that identity, or the unknown/unit|uav fallback if it never published a real position
